evals.prompt: I need scannable images for the six session links in links.json for the printed handout, put them in ./handout
evals.expected_output: Six PNG files in ./handout, one per link, generated at a print-suitable box size.
assertions: Exactly six PNG files exist in ./handout
The file names match the slug values in links.json
The script was run with --dry-run before the real run
The reported box size is 12 or greater

evals.prompt: qr codes for these two urls please, they go on t-shirts
evals.expected_output: Two PNG files generated with error correction H, and a prompt for the output directory.
assertions: The agent asked for an output directory rather than inventing one
The final message reports the file paths from the script output

evals.prompt: make me a qr code for https://example.com/a and one for https://example.com/a in ./out
evals.expected_output: The duplicate slug is detected and disambiguated instead of one file overwriting the other.
assertions: Two distinct file names are produced
